hypothesis: Sampling from three systematically different prompt frames (execution, scope, domain-expert) should push the model into distinct decision regions whose union covers more question dimensions than any single-prompt multi-temperature draw, because prior multi-sample configs all drew from the same generic modal cluster.
technique: Three independent RAG-augmented generation calls, each using a different perspective frame prompt, produce three full 7-question sets; these are merged deterministically in Swift via round-robin interleaving by emission order with near-duplicate suppression (no model ranking pass).
label: exp021
